name: magic-router
description: Stateless encrypted links: a Cloudflare Worker that stores nothing. Links carry their own AES-256-GCM encrypted destination, unlocked by password (Argon2id), passkey (WebAuthn PRF), or keypair (hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM) — with Shamir thresholds, time-locks, signed seals and secret-text payloads.
